APB.title: Apartment with Balcony
APB.description: The apartment has two well-defined rooms, with the bathroom centrally located for easy access from both. The first room is equipped with a double bed. The second room offers both a double bed and a sofa bed. This layout ensures maximum comfort and flexibility for guests.

DBB.title: Double Room with Balcony
DBB.description: All double rooms with a balcony offer delightful views and are equipped with private bathrooms with showers, ensuring complete privacy and comfort. Each room features a double bed, creating a spacious and comfortable area for relaxation and enjoying the scenery.

DB.title: Double Room without Balcony
DB.description: Our double rooms without a balcony are comfortable and intimate, including private bathrooms with showers, guaranteeing privacy and convenience. Each of these rooms offers a generous double bed, creating an ideal space for rest and relaxation.

SB.title: Suite with Balcony
SB.description: Our exclusive suite includes two interconnected rooms with a balcony, creating a spacious and private area with outdoor access. Each of these welcoming rooms is equipped with a comfortable double bed, ensuring a relaxing and intimate stay for our guests.

TPB.title: Triple Room with Balcony
TPB.description: All triple rooms with a balcony are equipped with a comfortable double bed and a sofa bed, providing extra generous space for relaxation and additional accommodation. Perfect for families or larger groups, these rooms with a balcony add extra comfort and a pleasant perspective for a wonderful stay.

TP.title: Triple Room without Balcony
TP.description: Our triple rooms without a balcony are equipped with a comfortable double bed and a cleverly integrated single bed in the wardrobe to maximize space. This smart arrangement offers our guests increased flexibility and comfort during their stay.

dec23.title: December 23
dec23.desc: Enjoy a warm welcome with Bucovina traditions.

dec24.title: December 24
dec24.desc: At 10 AM, take a horse-drawn sleigh ride, then enjoy an outdoor meal with pork feast, barbecue and cauldron roast, along with mulled wine, hot plum brandy and delicious Poale-n Brau. In the evening, at dinner, Carolers and Santa Claus will bring the magic of holidays.

dec25.title: December 25
dec25.desc: In a festive atmosphere, enjoy traditional dishes, selected drinks and good cheer with your loved ones, from 2:30 PM, to the rhythms of a live orchestra.

dec26.title: December 26
dec26.desc: You have the freedom to spend the day as you please - either on the ski slope in Campulung Moldovenesc, or exploring local beauties such as Moldovita and Voronet monasteries, pottery in Marginea (Black Ceramics) or a ride with Hutulca Steam Train from Moldovita.

dec29.title: December 29
dec29.desc: Begin your holiday immersed in authentic Bucovina atmosphere, with a traditional welcome reception and a festive dinner where you'll discover the first flavors of our local cuisine.

dec30.title: December 30
dec30.desc: At 10 AM, embark on an unforgettable horse-drawn sleigh adventure through Bucovina's winter landscape. Following this, enjoy a traditional outdoor feast featuring local specialties: 'pomana porcului' (traditional pork feast), barbecue and cauldron-cooked dishes, all accompanied by aromatic mulled wine, hot plum brandy, and our famous 'Poale-n Brau' pastries that will warm the atmosphere of this special day.

dec31.title: December 31
dec31.desc: After lunch, enjoy an extraordinary spectacle of Bucovina's New Year traditions, featuring groups of carolers, traditional goat and bear dances, and other authentic local customs. At 9:00 PM, the grand New Year's Eve party begins, where you'll savor an exceptional culinary feast: refined cold and hot appetizers, including turkey aspic, beef salad, marinated meatballs, fish specialties, hot dishes of turkey, piglet, and veal, all accompanied by live music and dancing until dawn.

jan1.title: January 1
jan1.desc: The first day of the year offers you the freedom to explore Bucovina's beauty at your own pace. Choose between: an active day on the ski slopes in Campulung Moldovenesc resort; a cultural circuit to the famous UNESCO painted monasteries (Moldovita, Voronet - known for its unique blue, Humor, and Sucevita); a visit to the craft workshops in Marginea, famous for their unique black pottery; or a picturesque journey on the Hutulca Steam Train through Moldovita Valley, offering spectacular views of Bucovina's rolling hills.
